title: The 2:30 AM Committee
cover_hook: I SAID I'D SLEEP AT TEN.

lines.line: Zeythar. It's 2:30 AM. I said I'd sleep at ten.
lines.say: Zeythar. It's two thirty A.M. I said I'd sleep at ten.
lines.delivery: Tired and flat, a little dramatic, a sigh in the voice, very late at night.

lines.line: You said that yesterday. And on Tuesday. I keep records.
lines.delivery: Deadpan and dry, unhurried, flat level pitch with no sing-song, matter-of-fact like reading from a ledger.

lines.line: I'm not even doing anything. I'm just replaying a conversation from 2019.
lines.say: I'm not even doing anything. I'm just replaying a conversation from twenty nineteen.
lines.delivery: Exasperated and fast, casual, rolling her eyes.

lines.line: Ah. The committee is in session.
lines.delivery: Amused and knowing, quietly dry, a slight smile in the voice.

lines.line: The what?
lines.delivery: Confused and quick, a short genuine question.

lines.line: Every awkward thing you have ever said, reviewed nightly. Attendance is mandatory.
lines.delivery: Completely deadpan, flat monotone like a dry official notice read aloud, measured, no sing-song.

lines.line: Why does it only meet at night?!
lines.delivery: Dramatic and whiny, a playful complaint, rising at the end.

lines.line: Because during the day, you never give it an appointment.
lines.delivery: Calm and plain, gently making the first real point, unhurried.

lines.line: Okay, wise one. How do I make it stop?
lines.delivery: Challenging and a bit sarcastic, teasing.

lines.line: Give it ten minutes before dinner. With a pen. Every worry, on paper.
lines.delivery: Practical and plain, simple calm instructions, even and unhurried.

lines.line: That's it? That's the ancient wisdom?
lines.delivery: Skeptical and unimpressed, half amused.

lines.line: The ancient wisdom was "go to sleep." Your species declined.
lines.say: The ancient wisdom was, go to sleep. ... Your species declined.
lines.delivery: Bone-dry deadpan, flat, a short beat before 'Your species', no sing-song.

lines.line: …Rude.
lines.delivery: Laughing despite herself, a short real laugh, then the word with a smile.
lines.alt_delivery: Amused despite herself, smiling while she says it, a breathy laugh in the voice.

lines.line: Can I tell you something weird? Night is the only time nobody needs anything from me.
lines.delivery: Quiet and honest, slower, soft and a little vulnerable, not dramatic.

lines.line: That is not weird. You are not avoiding sleep. You are taking back your day.
lines.delivery: Gentle at first, then sure; warm and steady, unhurried.

lines.line: …Oh.
lines.delivery: A soft realization, quiet, almost a breath.

lines.line: So take some of it back while the sun is up. Then the night won't have to steal it for you.
lines.delivery: Warm and unhurried, kind, gentle authority.

lines.line: Okay. Going to sleep. Right now.
lines.delivery: Resolved and brisk, decisive, a little playful.

lines.line: You have said that four times.
lines.delivery: Dry deadpan, flat monotone and matter-of-fact, no sing-song, no smile in the voice.

lines.line: Goodnight, Zeythar.
lines.delivery: Smiling and fond, warm and sleepy.

lines.line: It is 2:47.
lines.delivery: Deadpan and final: completely flat monotone, very dry and slow, no rise, like stating a plain fact.
